text:
maya: Heads-up — product expects an Asia daytime traffic shift next quarter (APAC marketing push). Need to model GPU hour impact and headroom for simultaneous chats. Anyone have a quick calc?

dmitri: Is this mainly concurrent sessions or longer contexts?

maya: Mostly concurrent sessions for QPS growth, avg context = 300 tokens, peak concurrency +50% during local evenings.

leah: We should estimate tokens/sec impact. If baseline is 120k tokens/sec cluster-wide, +50% concurrency ~ 180k tokens/sec, right? But that assumes same request mix.

samir: Quick back-of-envelope I did:
```
baseline_tokens_sec = 120000
peak_multiplier = 1.5
peak_tokens_sec = baseline_tokens_sec * peak_multiplier  # 180k
avg_tokens_per_request = 300
estimated_concurrent_requests = peak_tokens_sec / (avg_tokens_per_request / avg_response_time)
```
But we need avg_response_time in seconds per request (depends on batching & kv-cache).

maya: For our current config avg_response_time ~ 0.8s for 4k context at p95 during busy periods. Plugging that gives ~480 concurrent requests.

ops-bot: metric snapshot: apac-gpu-util=72% last 24h, regional-network-loss=0.2%, avg-kv-hit=18%

caroline: If APAC pushes to 480 concurrent, we need to reserve ~2.2x current APAC GPU hours to maintain <80% util headroom, assuming same node mix. That affects our Dedicated commit calc.

dmitri: Two complications: 1) cross-region egress and interconnect costs spike when traffic routes to EU for failover. 2) some older nodes (v1) have 30% worse tokens/sec. Are we accounting for node heterogeneity?

leah: Good call. I propose we model three scenarios: conservative (no cache gains, older nodes stick around), expected (gradual migration to q4 nodes + 20% kv-hit), and optimistic (cache jumps to 35%). Can someone assemble GPU-hour numbers for each?

samir: I'll run a short sim tomorrow. Need current distribution: number of v1 vs v2 vs quantized hosts in apac, plus average batch size.

maya: @samir, add networking failover case where eu fallback adds 15ms median and +8% egress cost. We need to show cost delta if 10% of traffic fails over.

caroline: Also include reserved vs on-demand pricing difference in the calc. If we can commit to 3 months of reserved for APAC, unit GPU-hour drops ~22%. Show that in cost per token.

ops-bot: ticket created INF-APAC-PEAK-2026 for simulation outputs and follow-up meeting.

dmitri: For headroom target: I recommend keeping 20% spare tokens/sec capacity after autoscale buffer to avoid increased tail latencies. That means plan for 216k tokens/sec in expected scenario.

leah: Agree. If expected = 180k, add 20% buffer => 216k. We'll translate that to GPU count using our benchmark 18k tokens/sec per GPU (v2) and 12k for v1.

maya: Action items: samir run sim with node mix + kv-hit ranges; caroline run cost delta (reserved vs on-demand vs burst through partner); leah produce tokens->GPU mapping table. Sync tomorrow 9am PT. :white_check_mark: 

caroline: Quick note — if we push more caching, we must update Optimize recommendations so customers don't get unexpected perf changes.

samir: on it, I'll dump sim outputs into INF-APAC-PEAK-2026 and ping here when done.

maya: Thanks all — want a short executive summary for GTM and finance by EOD after sims.
